name: Ketlen Souza
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A Brazilian strawweight on a two-fight win streak (a first-round KO of Ariane Carnelossi in June); 4-3 in the UFC, with two split-decision losses.

how_they_fight.Striking: Accurate (about 53%) and hits hard; three first-round finishes in her last five.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Submitted Yazmin Jauregui in round one (2024).
how_they_fight.Defense: Absorbs about 3.9 a minute; defense is middling.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Her close fights go to split decisions.

keys_to_beat: Take her down and win rounds
